These studies use defined subsets of Shale Network data to investigate groundwater chemistry, methane, and the effects of hydrocarbon development. Each page links a publication with its data source and describes the geographic and temporal scope.

The collections are not complete surveys of every water source in a region. The dates in dataset titles identify a compilation or release; consult the source files for sampling dates. For a whole-database archive, see [data access](data-access.qmd).
